text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, we were able to treat it early
and it is
non-life-threatening, but I cannot
recommend that she continue work
as a
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I see... Well, I knew that this day would
come sooner or later. I'm
sorry, Bell.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-it's nothing you need to apologize for!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If anything, it should be me for not getting
any stronger this whole
time...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Given the circumstances, it is decided that
it is best that the chief
trainer moves on to
retirement.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
<username>, I'd like
you to take over. I trust you.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, I know that things will be just
fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her official retirement comes into effect
two weeks from now. I've
accepted the job
of chief trainer, but it is up to Mejiro
Dober if she
wishes to stay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For that reason, I make an effort to better
understand her feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but can this wait? I'd like to focus
on my training right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but can we talk about this
another time? I'd like to
concentrate on
my training right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
She placed all her faith in me, but I was
never able to even give her
one win. I
need to change that before it's too late.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
She placed all her faith in me, but I was
never able to even give her
one win. I
need to change that before it's too late.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I only have two weeks, so I need to do
everything I can right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the next few days, I'm busy with the
handover and have little time
for much
else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When those tasks finally come to an end, I
can't help but think of
Mejiro Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Eh? You...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Eh? Oh, Assistant Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Shut up! Leave me alone!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Please, would you leave me be? I told you
that I don't have much
time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I HAVE to push myself. Because I'm so weak!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I HAVE to push myself. Because I'm so weak!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I've always, always been so weak!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I thought I would be able to start winning
right away. To be able to
run with
confidence like Bright... To be as strong as
Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
As a member of the Mejiro family, there's
so much I want to prove.
But I...

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And we have our first-place finisher! The
other runners follow close
behind!
Everyone, a big round of applause for
everyone giving it their
best!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Oh, number 8 Mejiro Dober is rounding
the last turn! She was a little
late out of
the gate, but she hasn't given up!

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
You're doing your best! Just keep it up!
Just a little farther! You can
do it!

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... gasp...

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
Doing your best? "Keep it up"? "It's okay"?
I've never heard anyone
say those things
to Ryan and the others...

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
They always yell about how fast and
amazing Bright and Ryan are...
But not for
me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That was a devastating day for me. I
messed up at the start and
finished
practically a whole lap behind everyone
else. I've felt that
others have been
laughing at me ever since.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I always feel ashamed and powerless... My
heart starts to feel like it's
trying to escape
my chest, and my legs begin to feel like
they're not
even my own...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can't run properly in front of
people anymore! No one
else at the
academy is like this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I felt myself getting slightly better with
Trainer's guidance, but now
I'm going to
lose her too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So I have to do something! I have to win a
race, even if it means
pushing myself this
hard!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm such a weakling, but I have to change
that even if I have to do it
alone!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You mean to say that things will be okay if
you take over as my
trainer? That things
will work out? Don't make me laugh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Have you even been listening to anything
I've been saying?! I'm a
weakling, and I
always have been!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Keep going, keep goooing! Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I just know that I would face a repeat of
that scrimmage race if I just
let things be,
however.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I just know that I would face a repeat of
that scrimmage race if I just
let things be,
however.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So I was thinking that talking to you could
be some good mental
training for me! You
can do that much as my assistant trainer,
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So I was hoping... maybe I could talk with
you to help me build some
mental
fortitude. Would that be okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
She placed all her faith in me, but I was
never able to even give her
one win. I
need to change that before it's too late.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
She placed all her faith in me, but I was
never able to even give her
one win. I
need to change that before it's too late.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I only have two weeks, so I need to do
everything I can right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She hasn't given up this entire time,
chasing after her goal of winning
a race in
front of the eyes of many.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I... I'm not...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I believe in her capabilities, even if she
chooses to polish them alone.
I want her to
understand, though, that if she needs any
support, then
I'll be waiting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try my best to make that known to her as
she dashes away into the
night.
